run_clip: run the CLIP vision-language model to generate image and text embeddings via vLLM
run_dse_qwen2_vl: run the DSE Qwen2-VL model to generate image and text embeddings with placeholder support
run_qwen3_vl: run the Qwen3-VL embedding model to generate text, image, and combined embeddings
run_siglip: run the SigLIP model to generate image and text embeddings via vLLM
run_vlm2vec: run the VLM2Vec model to generate image, text, and combined embeddings
